name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: Field or ghost trigger for a date, a range, or a date and a time: a calendar popover that opens on the selected day, optional range presets, and editable time fields with slot lists that show each duration. Radix flavor.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/date-picker. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#date-picker.
